articles.title: Huberdeau 'touched' by Flames support in long-awaited return to ice
Flames Drop OT Decision To Blackhawks
Greig and Cousins provide heart and soul for Sens in comeback win

out.detail: upper body injury, did not travel after leaving Saturday's game vs. Chicago following a hit from Wyatt Kaiser

away.summary: The Flames (10-12-2) are projected to use Devin Cooley in goal over Dustin Wolf for Monday's game in Ottawa. Calgary is dealing with injuries to Kevin Bahl (lower body) and Martin Pospisil (upper body), with Pospisil not traveling after leaving Saturday's 4-3 overtime loss to Chicago. Brennan Othmann and Brayden Pachal are scratched, while forward Sam Morton was recalled from the AHL and will play.

home.summary: The Senators (15-6-3) are projected to start Linus Ullmark in goal against Calgary. Ottawa will use the same lineup from Saturday's 4-2 win over the Kings, with Nick Cousins returning after missing four games with an upper-body injury. Injuries continue to sideline Warren Foegele, William Eklund, Andre Burakovsky, and Hayden Hodgson, while Carter Yakemchuk and Tyler Boucher are scratched.
